tasks.short: Prepare, administer and grade progress assessments

steps.what: Prepare tests and assignments aligned with learning goals and student access needs
Administer tests and assignments with appropriate accommodations and observe student responses
Grade student work and evaluate progress considering assistance and assessment conditions

tasks.design: Keep accessible assessment preparation, administration and contextual grading with the teacher using {DOCS}. A general scoring pilot does not establish reliable interpretation of adapted responses or assistance in this setting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assessment validity depends on what the student can demonstrate under appropriate conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Generic scoring aids do not establish a substitute for contextual progress evaluation.
tasks.still_hard: An apparently incorrect response can reflect access barriers rather than lack of understanding.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher distinguishes assistance, communication differences and actual learning.
tasks.altitude: Assessment decision rights and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss assessment access barriers and criterion validity

evidence.claim: CheckMate suggests scores for open questions in a seven-teacher pilot; the digest does not establish validity for adapted special-education assessments.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher-created progress assessments, excluding standardized tests owned by the separate task and later student record administration.
Teacher s1 produces criteria and access requirements; s2 produces responses and observations. No structured independent-performance flag is presumed or automatically inferred.
Retain native documents; no new assessment system proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes. Disagree with the amplification prior absent a verified closed-item workload.
unknowns: Assessment formats, accommodations and marking criteria
research_questions: Does any separate fixed-key marking workload exist that preserves the validity of adapted responses?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; preparation, supported administration and contextual grading retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare classes and provide written preparation evidence

steps.what: Prepare assigned classes and capture lesson goals, activities, resources and access arrangements
Format written evidence of class preparation for the supervisor's requested view
Check the written evidence against actual preparation and show it to the supervisor
outputs: verified preparation evidence shared with supervisor

tasks.design: Configure a reusable preparation view in {DOCS} that renders teacher-entered lesson fields into the requested evidence format. The teacher keeps pedagogical preparation and verifies the exact document before sharing; the system does not invent preparation or student supports.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparation can be reformatted into a second document for supervisory requests.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and reusable views can remove duplicate formatting.
tasks.still_hard: A complete-looking document may not reflect real class preparation.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher checks practical readiness and suitability for the students.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate formatting with unchanged pedagogical responsibility.

reach.task: Explain preparation evidence using a consistent lesson view
reach.learn: Evidence requirements and privacy-aware document sharing

evidence.claim: Rendering existing preparation fields into a supervisor view is an E1 design from model knowledge; no special-education labour saving is measured in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is class preparation and requested written evidence; assessment design and other material adaptation tasks must not duplicate preparation hours.

Teacher s1 captures date, class identifier, curriculum goal, activity sequence, timing, resource references and already-approved access arrangements within its60 hours. No separate writer supplies them for free; missing fields remain for manual completion.
Use native document views before custom code. Limit student-identifying information and verify the permitted supervisor audience in s3.
Scenario applies only where a separately formatted evidence document is actually required; if the existing lesson view suffices, formatting already vanishes and no new saving is claimed.
unknowns: Current evidence requirement and genuine duplicate formatting effort
research_questions: Can the supervisor accept the native preparation view while preserving evidence accuracy and access controls?

already_counted.description: Evidence and audience review before sharing

approvals.approved_version: Exact preparation document version, class, date, contents and supervisor audience; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gross25 minus4 upkeep gives net21. E1 duplicate-evidence scenario; more manual completion and review reduces net to5-16. Without duplicate formatting the benefit is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer standardized assessments and interpret strengths and needs

steps.what: Administer standardized ability and achievement tests under authorised procedures and accommodations
Interpret standardized results and administration conditions to determine student strengths and needs

tasks.design: Retain authorised administration and contextual interpretation using test materials in {DOCS}. Existing publisher scoring aids remain part of current practice; their runtime is not a new teacher saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standardization and accommodations constrain administration and interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Generic drafting and scoring tools do not validate altered standardized tests.
tasks.still_hard: Accommodation or administration differences can limit score interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises what the results can and cannot support.
tasks.altitude: Assessment authority and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss limitations of a standardized assessment result

evidence.claim: Retaining authorised standardized assessment and contextual interpretation is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is standardized testing, excluding teacher-made assessments and specialist diagnostic work.
Publisher materials supply authorised scoring procedures and teacher s1 produces responses and observations; no free strengths or disability label is presumed.
Keep existing approved scoring aids; no custom testing tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes; national testing and professional authority requirements need confirmation.
unknowns: Test licences, authorised users and accommodations
research_questions: Which administration differences limit comparison to the test norms?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; administration and interpretation remain fully counted without counting existing scoring runtime.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Guide parents in community support and practical skills

steps.what: Meet parents and guardians to guide resource use and teach support skills for impairments

tasks.design: Keep personal family guidance and practical skill teaching with the teacher. Existing verified references in {DOCS} support the meeting; no automatic service-eligibility advice is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Family circumstances and understanding require individual discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Reference access does not replace practising skills and answering family concerns.
tasks.still_hard: A recommended resource may not fit the family's access or current circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher listens, checks understanding and adapts explanation respectfully.
tasks.altitude: Family guidance responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify a family support referral with appropriate authority
reach.learn: Community service boundaries and referral practice

evidence.claim: Retaining personal parent guidance and support-skill teaching is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is the family meeting, excluding resource-directory maintenance, specialist therapy and administrative scheduling.
Existing school support staff maintain resource references and approved methods through current duties; no free structured service-available or eligible flag is assumed.
Retain existing references; no custom guidance tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes; overlapping parent meetings count once in roll-up.
unknowns: Family communication needs and current community support routes
research_questions: Which skills need demonstration and family practice rather than a written handout?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; direct guidance and skill teaching retain full time.

role.altitude: Remove duplicate preparation-evidence formatting where it exists while preserving assessment and family guidance.
reach: Explain assessment limitations to school psychologists
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who maintains contextual assessment and close family support while avoiding duplicate preparation paperwork.
